| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Tolerance** `tolerance` | 32 | 0 to 255 | Largest color distance from the sampled color that is still selected. |
| **Contiguous** `contiguous` | on | On or off | Select only matching pixels connected to the clicked pixel. |
| **Sample size** `sampleSize` | 3 by 3 average | Point sample, 3 by 3 average, 5 by 5 average | How many pixels around the click make the sampled color. |
| **Color space** `colorSpace` | RGB | RGB, HSV, Lab | Where the color distance is measured. |
| **Anti-alias** `antiAlias` | on | On or off | Softens the edge by averaging each pixel with its 3 by 3 neighbors. |
| **Feather** `feather` | 0 | 0 to 250 px | Softens the edge of the new selection. |
